faq.title: Questions about MBSuite?
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about the platform, deployment and licensing.

items.q: Does MBSuite support Thai accounting and tax workflows?
items.a: The platform includes accounting tools and features for preparing Thai tax data and forms, with RD API integration options available.

items.q: Does it include AI tools for accounting?
items.a: Yes. AI Chat and AI Audit can help answer questions and review potentially unusual entries, alongside tax processing tools.

items.q: Do I need an annual subscription?
items.a: No. In addition to an annual subscription, perpetual licensing is available. Contact our team for details.

items.q: Can I install the system myself?
items.a: The system supports Docker deployment and lets you configure modules to fit your business workflows.
You can schedule backups to Google Drive and business summary updates through Google Workspace.

items.q: Can I enable only selected modules?
items.a: Yes. Choose the modules that fit your business, including sales, expenses, payroll, inventory and AI.
